The first ens. has a visible period; the later l’ens does not. Both short forms remain unexpanded. The two resp. occurrences remain abbreviated, and the final two-bar sign in On a de = is transcribed as =. The expansion même is recorded only in the abbreviation list.

The live à precedes the crossed aux cluster. The heavily overworked surface cluster is left uncertain, with no invented separate cancelled fragment. Its ending and f-like stroke favor surface; grammar alone is not used to choose between surface and H’s l’espace.

The first d’un cran is interlinear and marked inserted, as is the second d’un cran with its more explicit insertion leader. The live words preceding and following the struck indiqué remain in their actual order.

The phrase du type infinity resp.0 following the two rho_infinity rows is preserved as written. Its relation to the following rho0 formula could explain the juxtaposition; the text does not authorize replacing resp. by vers or deleting 0. This is an unresolved interpretive tension, not an ink correction.

The manuscript’s double quotes around adjacentes and rotation are rendered by two backticks and two apostrophes. Only the six-index label 0,1 has a clearly separate comma; the neighboring 1infinity and 0infinity labels do not.

No source drawing files beyond H’s prose description were supplied. H’s broad acknowledgement of curved rotation arrows is not treated as an assertion of every local direction. The central loop reversal and restored connector geometry are therefore charged to C, while H’s concrete missing or unwritten labels are recorded separately. No external H drawing project was assessed.

The central loop’s upper head points left, so it is counterclockwise. The geometric order 0 at the lower-left, 1 at the right, infinity above is consistent with this, but the head itself decides. No expected orientation was used to add a head where the ink remained doubtful.

The small raised stroke above/right of Ra initially suggested a superscript 1 to the main reader. Comparison of the two wings and hooked shaft established an upward connector arrow. The main reader withdrew the superscript suggestion. The final label remains Ra(1), with a separate short upward arrow.

The right-side rho1(r) label is heavily retraced but live. The crossing of strokes within it is not treated as deletion. The late extra rho_infinity in (5) has an independent cancellation and remains a deleted, uncertain reading.
